name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-yandex-audience
title: Yandex Audience MCP
description: MCP server for Yandex Audience API: segments (CRM, lookalike, pixel), pixels, grants.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_AUDIENCE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Yandex OAuth token, sent as `Authorization: OAuth …`. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_AUDIENCE_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: API host override (https://api-audience.yandex.com for international accounts).

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_AUDIENCE_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on 429 (5xx/network retried for GET only).
